title: WINDOWS ARE A 90 PERCENT CARD
why: His Q43: windows are a centred card with an X in the corner taking nearly the whole screen. The windows were a slab 14 px from the edge with a clipped tick. Now a card with a 5 percent margin all round, 4 px corners, no tick, the X and credits inside its top right.
now: Shop, codex, trophies and the other windows are a centred 90 percent card.
